messages:
zoe (partnerships): quick thread to lock the private-offer playbook: SKU floors, reservation slope bands, and renewal opt-in mechanics. want simple for partners and sales.
max (pricing): suggest minimal config: sku_floor (hours/mo), bands=[trial(0-90d), ramp(91-270d, partial credit), committed(>=365d)], non-stackable discounts by default. will publish calc sheet.
leah-legal: legal redlines: no implicit renewals, renewal UI must have checkbox + timestamp. marketing credits ok if capped and non-transferable. need partner MSA to confirm co-terms.
henry-sales: need an SFDC-friendly example: "50 GPU-hrs/mo floor -> $X/mo committed price" plus one-slide pitch. also want 30d notice window before renewal.
priya-ops: ops ask: provide a machine-readable rule blob for billing. prefer a tiny JSON schema per SKU. will implement invoice_credit vs post_bill_rebate modes.
nana (bot): note: spelling: ana-marketing (autocorrect)
ana (marketing): (ana-marketing): co-marketing: prefer to wait for first pilot go-live for public case study. can do partner teaser social posts earlier if partner ok. need logos + approvals. 10 business days creative.
max (pricing): edge case: if customer moves bands mid-cycle, prorate credits daily and ensure idempotent math. will document formulas by EOD Fri.
leah-legal: also add a clause preventing stacking of the early-adopter credits with year-one discounts. i'll draft a paragraph.
zoe (partnerships): actions:
- leah-legal: MSA vs addendum confirmation + draft clause by Tue
- max: finalize slope calc + mid-cycle proration rules by Fri
- priya: sample JSON schema + ticket for billing impl by Wed
- henry: SFDC example + pilot candidate list by Wed
- ana-marketing: creative timeline + approval checklist by next Mon
please reply with blockers. :handshake:
